certificate.family: gated vault: near-plugins v0.5.1 Upgradable behind a certificate gate, build v2
certificate.statement: Testnet demonstration certificate. In the Lean model of the gated vault, every change of the code installs code whose hash had, when the registry was asked, a certificate that was not revoked, of the accepted kind and from an accepted attestor; that code was staged at least the staging duration before the deploy call and its hash was the visible staged hash all that time; the deploy batch was created by the contract's own callback. This wasm is a feature build of the modelled source: it differs from build v1 in the value version() returns and in nothing else.
assumptions: The contract account has no access keys, and no receipt calling a plugin or acl method has it as predecessor.
The registry account runs the pinned registry wasm, has no access keys, and its answer reaches the callback unchanged.
The model is a transcription of the contract by hand; the wasm was compared with it by scenarios and a trace monitor on the nearcore runtime, not by proof.
After a code change the statement continues only if the installed code is again the modelled contract.
Gas, storage staking, JSON decoding and collisions of sha256 are outside the model.
